convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iMA, iSAR). Simple entry/exit rules with fixed lot sizing. Standard Trade library .mqh includes are MQL5 boilerplate, not custom trading logic. No multi-timeframe, no hedging, no grid, no martingale.

derived_values.name: Adjusted point value for 3/5 digit brokers
derived_values.formula: Point()*10 when Digits==3 or Digits==5, else Point()

derived_values.name: ExtTrailingStep
derived_values.used_by: Trailing stop activation threshold and step

other_exits: None - EA does not close positions on opposite signal, only opens new position if flat

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses OR logic: long if (SAR < MA) OR (Close[ma_shift] < MA), short if (SAR > MA) OR (Close[ma_shift] > MA). The ma_shift parameter (default 2) offsets the close price comparison bar. Trailing stop activation requires profit > ExtTrailingStop + ExtTrailingStep (combined threshold of 20 pips default), then modifies SL to PriceCurrent - ExtTrailingStop. If a position already exists, the EA only trails it and returns without checking for new entries. The filling type auto-detects FOK > IOC > RETURN priority.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Two built-in indicators (SMA, Parabolic SAR) with standard params. Entry is OR-combination of SAR vs MA and Close[shift] vs MA. Trailing stop has a combined activation threshold (TrailingStop+TrailingStep) before modifying SL. No new-bar guard means signals fire every tick — must track position state to avoid repeated opens. Digit adjustment logic (multiply by 10 for 3/5 digit) must be replicated. Filling type detection is broker-specific and can default to FOK in Python backtest. The standard Trade library includes are boilerplate and do not require separate conversion.
